catalog.name: Palimpsest Evidence Atlas
catalog.description: Machine-readable catalog of Palimpsest censorship, information-control, network-health, state-telemetry, and model-evaluation datasets.
catalog.cadence_semantics: Dataset cadence is the intended collection target, not a guaranteed website publication interval; artifact timestamps and evidence_state are authoritative.

datasets.name: Domestic Discourse Tightening Index
datasets.description: Ranks topics receiving censor attention in China Digital Times' curated deletion and directive feeds; it measures attention allocation, not a population deletion rate.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest code and derived fields; upstream rights retained

datasets.name: OONI Great Firewall signal
datasets.description: Windowed China blocking rates from openly published OONI measurements, with denominators and per-test evidence kept visible.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 source data

datasets.name: OONI bulk evidence warehouse
datasets.description: Hourly, country- and test-scoped replication of OONI JSONL evidence with byte budgets, checksums, resumable manifests, and privacy-minimized public rollups.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

datasets.name: Inside View
datasets.description: Controlled DNS comparisons from consented Globalping cloud probes in mainland China against independent control locations.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest output; provider terms apply

datasets.name: BLEEDTHROUGH DNS-injector telemetry
datasets.description: Bounded external-vantage measurements of coarse DNS-injector response-process changes across declared Chinese network groups. Only the privacy-minimized v2 relay is public; target IPs, prefix samples, baselines, and probe-level observations remain private. A response transition is a measurement lead, not attribution of an actor or intent.

license.name: MIT for sanitized Palimpsest method and aggregates; upstream RIPE terms apply

datasets.name: Cloudflare passive TCP telemetry
datasets.description: Country-level reset and timeout stage distributions from Cloudflare's passive network sample; useful for corroboration, never treated as causal proof of censorship.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0

datasets.name: In-path interference
datasets.description: OONI-derived middlebox rewriting and transport anomaly families kept separate from reachability and execution failures.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 source data

datasets.name: Censored Planet side-channel
datasets.description: Independent longitudinal Internet-wide interference rates and alert events from the Censored Planet observatory.

license.name: Upstream terms; Palimpsest publishes attribution and provenance

datasets.name: IODA outage evidence
datasets.description: Independent BGP, active-probing, and telescope outage events used to distinguish censorship from wider connectivity loss.

license.name: Upstream terms; Palimpsest derived output MIT

datasets.name: net4people event stream
datasets.description: Recent, publicly discussed censorship and circumvention events extracted from the net4people research forum.

license.name: Repository and contributor terms apply

datasets.name: Circumvention demand
datasets.description: Tor usage telemetry used as a demand-side cross-check, with transport changes retained as context rather than causal proof.

license.name: CC0 source data

datasets.name: Vantage fusion interval
datasets.description: Fuses OONI, Censored Planet, and event evidence into an uncertainty interval; it refuses to publish a false point estimate when vantages diverge.
sources: Palimpsest derived from OONI, Censored Planet, net4people

license.name: Mixed upstream licenses; see component datasets

datasets.name: Weibo allowed-attention denominator
datasets.description: Archived hot-search boards provide the visible-attention denominator needed to avoid treating topic popularity as deletion pressure.

license.name: Upstream rights retained; derived metadata MIT

datasets.name: GDELT cross-signal
datasets.description: Compares topics drawing domestic censor attention with global news coverage and abstains when the global denominator is unavailable.

license.name: GDELT source terms; Palimpsest derived output MIT

datasets.name: GitHub as refuge
datasets.description: Watches a bounded public repository panel for disappearance and pressure events without equating an API failure with removal.

license.name: Repository-specific upstream licenses

datasets.name: Public research-corpus ledger
datasets.description: Tracks exact default-branch commit cursors and aggregate Git ref counts for five censorship-research repositories without republishing notice bodies, affected identifiers, URL test targets, keyword lists, or routing rules.

license.name: Metadata-only aggregate; repository-specific upstream licenses

datasets.name: Wayback reconstruction
datasets.description: Reconstructs prior public states for watched URLs and separates deletion, mutation, reachability, and archival absence.

license.name: Internet Archive terms; Palimpsest metadata MIT

datasets.name: App Storefront panel
datasets.description: Tracks a fixed app panel across Apple storefronts and reports delistings only when controls and source health pass.

license.name: Apple service terms; Palimpsest derived output MIT

datasets.name: AppleCensorship country corpus
datasets.description: Country-level app availability composition and peer comparison from GreatFire's public AppleCensorship corpus.

license.name: Upstream terms; Palimpsest attribution required

datasets.name: Blocklist archaeology
datasets.description: Version-to-version keyword additions with hashes and source provenance; evidence samples are bounded and interpretation remains separate.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 source data

datasets.name: Baike redaction differential
datasets.description: Entity-page comparison method retained for authorized access; the public artifact explicitly reports when collection is unavailable.

license.name: Upstream rights retained

datasets.name: Official-data darkness
datasets.description: Tracks publication freshness across official monetary, statistical, exchange, and rail surfaces while separating unreachability from missing publication.

license.name: Official-source rights retained; Palimpsest metadata MIT

datasets.name: China economic telemetry
datasets.description: Bitemporal observations of official CFETS and related benchmarks, retaining publication and effective dates separately.

license.name: Official-source rights retained; Palimpsest metadata MIT

datasets.name: CNY fixing gap
datasets.description: Same-day comparison between China's central parity and independent central-bank reference rates, with explicit abstention when date parity is absent.

license.name: Official-source rights retained; Palimpsest derived output MIT

datasets.name: Physical-economy believability band
datasets.description: A transparent band from electricity, rail freight, credit, coal, and steel telemetry that is kept as a counterpoint rather than a replacement statistic.

license.name: Official-source rights retained; Palimpsest derived output MIT

datasets.name: Stock Connect flows
datasets.description: Weekday northbound and southbound flow observations from HKEX, with source units and publication dates preserved.

license.name: HKEX source terms; Palimpsest metadata MIT

datasets.name: Silence Index
datasets.description: Compares domestic censor-attention topics with globally visible coverage and an allowed-attention denominator; abstention is a first-class output.
sources: Palimpsest derived from DDTI, Weibo, GDELT

license.name: Mixed upstream licenses; see component datasets

datasets.name: Anytime-valid event flags
datasets.description: Conformal change alarms over source histories with explicit reporting, stale, closed, and no-data states.

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: Multiplicity-controlled board alarm
datasets.description: Layer-aware e-value board that pays for multiple testing and shows evidence coverage beside every alarm state.

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: Coverage guard
datasets.description: Detects sample and source-coverage degradation so a smaller denominator is not silently presented as a calmer signal.

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: Cross-layer timing
datasets.description: Daily-collapsed lead and lag estimates across independent layers; it labels temporal order and never upgrades it to causation.

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: Forecast ledger
datasets.description: Scores Palimpsest's own forecasts against later observations, including misses and results that are not yet scoreable.

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: Information Erasure Observatory
datasets.description: Composite across network, narrative, and model layers, computed only over reporting layers and committed to a hash-chained ledger.

license.name: Mixed upstream licenses; composite method MIT

datasets.name: Palimpsest Newsroom
datasets.description: Deterministic, evidence-linked news dispatches projected from the normalized OSINT China roll-up without model-written claims or causal inference.

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: Palimpsest Evidence Wire
datasets.description: Metadata-only RSS and Atom intake from a closed allowlist, normalized into versioned event dossiers with source-by-source coverage receipts, independence groups, declared scan links and explicit limitations. It republishes neither article bodies nor inferred causes.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest metadata and derived fields; upstream rights retained

datasets.name: China Economic Pulse
datasets.description: Revision-safe synthesis of official economic releases, market prints and physical telemetry. It preserves as-of clocks, source independence, release gaps and revisions, and abstains from a composite state claim until declared coverage gates pass; it is not an estimate of true GDP.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest synthesis; mixed upstream rights retained

datasets.name: Palimpsest Investigations Desk
datasets.description: Review-gated research leads assembled from hash-bound public evidence, explicit counterevidence and falsification conditions. Cases remain research leads until every human publication gate passes; the system does not automate allegations, motives or causal attribution.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest structure and analysis; upstream rights retained

datasets.name: Palimpsest Evidence Mesh
datasets.description: Deterministic, no-network inventory of public aggregate evidence, analytical context, provenance lineage, freshness and reuse rights. It maps eligible inputs without copying private data, identifying people, joining records into allegations or treating partner artifacts as automatically admitted evidence.
sources: Pinned aggregate Intelligence Commons partner artifacts

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest metadata; upstream rights and restrictions retained per resource

datasets.name: Palimpsest Machine Analysis Desk
datasets.description: Deterministic machine-written evidence analyses with sentence-level citations, source-lineage de-duplication, explicit countercases, limitations, falsifiers, correction history and reproducibility gates. It conducts no human interviews, makes no person-level allegations and publishes an AbstentionReport when its declared evidence threshold is not met.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest structure and analysis; upstream rights retained

datasets.name: Primary Document Archive
datasets.description: Metadata-only receipts for exact bytes captured from a closed registry of official statistics, transport, energy, satellite, survey and exchange-filing surfaces. Every revision keeps separate publication, retrieval and acceptance clocks; a captured catalog is not a parsed observation.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest receipts; publisher rights and terms apply to retained source bytes

datasets.name: Reviewed Corroboration Ledger
datasets.description: Conservative event-to-primary-document candidates and human decisions. A topical match never confirms an event automatically; only an accepted release-document edge with compatible clocks and a distinct independence group can increase support.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest linkage metadata; upstream rights retained

datasets.name: Frozen Multiprotocol Network Rounds
datasets.description: Longitudinal receipts for a frozen target panel with protocol, method, China cloud-ASN and region, same-round external control, routing and outage scope kept separate. Results describe the observed vantages and never a national censorship percentage.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest aggregate receipts; provider and upstream terms apply

datasets.name: Protected Human-Source Workflow Summary
datasets.description: Public aggregate readiness for pseudonymous, externally encrypted source records. Identity, contact details, attribution labels and note text stay in a private content-addressed store; consent, verification, safety and right-to-reply status are exposed only as package counts.

license.name: MIT for aggregate workflow metadata; protected records are not public

datasets.name: Newsroom Editorial Readiness Gate
datasets.description: Machine-recomputed publication floors for attributed wire briefs, explainers and investigations, combining evidence receipts with explicit human edit, fact-check, source-safety, right-to-reply, visual, citation and correction attestations. Passing never publishes automatically.

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: Generative Firewall Index
datasets.description: Frozen bilingual prompt suites measure refusal and state-narrative substitution in state-aligned models against separately interpreted controls.
sources: Hosted model APIs and sealed Palimpsest probe bank

license.name: MIT for method and derived scores; provider terms for outputs

datasets.name: Frontier refusal churn
datasets.description: Compares each model only with its own prior frozen-suite run and publishes churn separately from the closed v1 drift series.
sources: Hosted model APIs and sealed Palimpsest probe bank

license.name: MIT for method and derived scores; provider terms for outputs

datasets.name: Verifiable evaluation registry
datasets.description: Append-only, pre-registered model-evaluation runs with hash links, Merkle roots, and independently recomputable verification status.

license.name: MIT for registry code and metadata; provider terms for model outputs

datasets.name: AI eval claim assurance
datasets.description: Deterministic claim-by-claim audit of integrity, exact-prompt precommitment, raw-response recomputation, pipeline reproducibility, statistical design, independent human construct validation and unaffiliated replication. Publishes a claim ceiling instead of one composite quality score.
sources: Palimpsest public eval registry, protocols, readings and transcripts

license.name: MIT

datasets.name: AI Eval Journal
datasets.description: Evidence-bound articles about Palimpsest's AI-evaluation origins, method changes, failures and current claim ceiling. Every article carries limitations, a falsifier, verification commands and fresh SHA-256 receipts for its local evidence.
sources: Closed Palimpsest article records and explicitly cited public eval artifacts

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest text, method and structured records; cited upstream rights retained

datasets.name: Live Eval Findings
datasets.description: Continuously rebuilt analysis of the latest verified refusal-drift panel. Findings retain controls, denominators, Wilson intervals, counterreadings, limitations, falsifiers, sentence-level selectors and content-addressed revision receipts.
sources: Palimpsest refusal-drift reading, transcripts and verified eval registry

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest text, method and structured records; model-output provider terms remain applicable to cited transcripts

datasets.name: External integrity anchors
datasets.description: Deposits ledger roots outside Palimpsest's infrastructure and reports verification problems without hiding partial failure.

license.name: MIT
